Is it true that the reviews of Liate Clinic are questionable? Explanation of actual posted content and how the monitoring system works

「Are the reviews of Liate Clinic bad?」

“Are the monitoring systems you often see online really worth it?”

Many people who are thinking about consulting with the Liate Clinic may have questions like these.

Among the reviews posted online, some pointed out the pushiness of counseling and trouble canceling contracts, while others praised the slimming effects and staff service.

This article was posted by a user,Rieto Clinic reviews and reputationIntroducing.

togetherHow the monitor system worksYa,Early cancellation/refund guarantee/cooling-off conditionsWe will also explain about this.

If you are wondering whether or not you should consult the Reate Clinic, please refer to it.

What you can learn from this article
  • The reality of the reputation of Liate Clinic as seen from the reviews
  • The structure of the monitoring system that is said to be “suspicious” and “dangerous”
  • Total fees and monthly payment guidelines
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

For detailed management structure and editorial stance, please seeNorris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicinePlease check.

About Norris Beauty Clinic

Our clinic offers cosmetic medical treatments for women.

Click here for information on aesthetic medical treatments

*You can check the details by clicking the button

At Norris Beauty Clinic, we offer a wide range of treatment options, so we will be able to suggest treatments tailored to each patient.

Please consider this if you are interested in aesthetic medicine and treatments.

This article provides information about aesthetic medicine based on the knowledge of doctors.

Click here for the web reservation form

*You can check the details by clicking the button

Click here to register on LINE

*You can check the details by clicking the button

Management information of Norris Beauty Clinic

The reality of the reputation of Liate Clinic as seen from the reviews

There are many reviews and reputations about Liate Clinic, such as people who were able to experience the slimming effect.good reviewsand dissatisfaction with fees and counseling.bad reviewsIt is classified into two types.

Three perspectives of word-of-mouth reputation
  • Good reviews: Realized the slimming effect and satisfaction with staff service
  • Bad reviews: high fees and pressure on counseling
  • Google reviews: Differences in evaluation scores and number of reviews by hospital

The reason behind the wide disparity in reviews of the same clinic is the applicability of the monitoring system, compatibility with the staff in charge, and differences in the ability to respond to the frequency of hospital visits.

When reading reviews, do not rely on only good reviews or only bad reviews.Compare the content of the evaluation with your own situationThis is important in improving the accuracy of judgment.

In addition, the evaluation scores on Google Maps differ from clinic to clinic, and trends in customer satisfaction differ depending on the location even within the same Rieto clinic.

We will organize the actual state of reviews from the following three perspectives.

Many of the positive reviews include feeling the weight loss effect and being satisfied with the staff's service.

A good review of Liate Clinic says, ``I could feel the effects of the treatment」、「The explanation from the staff was thorough.” and other comments were written.

The actual reviews posted are as follows:

Not only will she guide you through the treatment, but she will also guide you through a diet that suits your style, and she never makes any unreasonable inducements.
If you continue the effects properly, you will gradually lose weight and it will be great.

Quote:Liate Clinic Yokohama Clinic｜Google Map

I was a little nervous as it was my first time, but when I told him that I had a complex about my lower body, he introduced me to a plan that matched my needs!
He is always available for consultation.
I hope it works, but I want to experience it as my last diet! !

Quote:Liate Clinic Yokohama Clinic｜Google Map

I have dieted and rebounded many times, but now that I know more about the principles than just my spirit, I feel that my weight and system are gradually changing.
The staff are kind and polite, so it's easy to come to the clinic, and I'm looking forward to seeing the results in the future.

Quote:Liate Clinic Yokohama Clinic｜Google Map

When it comes to satisfaction with the staff's response, there are many cases in which people leave favorable reviews if they feel that they did not receive unreasonable additional suggestions during counseling.

On the other hand, there are reviews that show different impressions of customer service depending on the person in charge, even at the same clinic, so care must be taken when generalizing evaluations of staff service.

Users who have visited the hospital multiple times tend to post many reviews that are satisfied with both the actual treatment effects and the staff's response.

When referring to good reviews,At what point of your first hospital visit?Let's check.

Bad reviews include high fees and pressure on counseling.

What is often mentioned in bad reviews is the number of additional suggestions during counseling and the finalThe total amount paid was higher than expected.This is the content.

We have confirmed multiple comments such as ``It was difficult to refuse the option,'' and ``Even after the monitor was applied, additional drug and management fees were incurred.''

The actual reviews posted are as follows:

Most of the discounts you see online are lies.
At the time of counseling, Mr. 〇〇 didn't take that kind of advertisement seriously, right? That makes it hard to say no.

Quote:Liate Clinic Yokohama Clinic｜Google Map

I wanted to try HYF and fat-dissolving injections, so I signed up for that amount, but at that time, I was repeatedly recommended the last diet and course of my life.

Quote:Liate Clinic Nagoyain｜Google Map

I went for a free consultation.
The receptionist, counselors, and nurses were all polite and nice. The doctor who interviewed me seemed very nice.
I signed a contract once, but ended up cooling off. The reason is definitely money.

Quote:Liate Clinic Nagoyain｜Google Map

If you are asked to sign a contract on the day of counseling, you will be required to sign a contract based on the Specified Commercial Transactions Law.cooling offsystem applies.

From the date of receipt of the contractWithin 8 daysIf so, you can request cancellation.

Regarding cancellation, there were comments such as ``Refund response was slow'' and ``Even after I informed them of my intention to cancel, I was held back.''

There are a certain number of reviews that say the high frequency of hospital visits is a burden, and there are also reports of cases of people canceling their contracts mid-way because the once-a-week pace didn't match with their work.

It is an effective self-defense measure to ask for a breakdown of the total plan price, drug costs, and management fees in writing before signing the contract, and not to sign it on the spot.

There are differences when comparing Google review ratings and number of reviews for each hospital.

Rieto Clinic has multiple clinics across the country, and the ratings on Google Maps vary depending on the clinic.

Clinics with high evaluation scores tend to have a large number of reviews, with a high concentration of positive posts regarding staff service and politeness of treatments.

On the other hand, at clinics with low evaluation scores, there were many reviews mentioning opacity in price explanations and oppressive counseling, and even with the same brand name,Customer experience varies by hospital.I understand that.

Three points for correctly reading Google reviews
  • Since the evaluation score and number of cases differ depending on the hospital, specify the base to check.
  • Clinics with few reviews have low ratings credibility.
  • Check the latest reviews within the last 3 months in chronological order

Google reviews can be posted anonymously, so we cannot independently verify the authenticity of the content. Don't make decisions based only on evaluation scores,Multiple review platformsWe recommend that you check the information.

Clinics with a small number of reviews have a small population even if they have a high evaluation score, so be careful when deciding on the content.

On the Google map page of the hospital you are considering visiting,Latest reviews (within the last 3 months)Let's check it in chronological order.

If the rating trends change between old and new reviews, it may be due to changes in staff or management policies.

Why is Liate Clinic said to be terrible in word of mouth? How the monitor system works

Liate Clinic's monitoring system is available only if the applicable conditions are met.Save money on treatment costsHere's how it works.

Benefits such as "18 months free" have a big impact, but the structure makes it difficult to communicate the benefit conditions and total cost.

Organizing the actual status of the monitor system from three perspectives
  • How benefits such as 18 months free and up to 80% OFF are applied
  • Applicable conditions such as weight, BMI, frequency of hospital visits, etc. required for monitor application
  • Gap between benefits and actual cost burden

If you sign a contract without accurately understanding how the system works,Unexpected cost burden and mismatch in the pace of hospital visitsThere is a risk that this may occur.

Here, we will explain how the benefits work, how they are calculated, and the conditions for application.

18 months free and up to 80% OFF is a system that discounts the difference from the regular price

``18 months free'' in Liate Clinic's monitoring system means that a portion of the monthly fees incurred under the regular plan will be waived for a certain period.

The monitor price is set by deducting 80% from the regular price.Treatment costs will not be reduced to zero.。

For example, the regular price for a plan that includes GLP-1 injection is600,000 yenIf this is set, the self-pay amount will be the following amount.

Calculation image when benefits are applied (e.g. when regular price is 600,000 yen)
  • When 80% OFF is applied: Self-pay 120,000 yen(Medicine fees and consultation fees are separate)
  • When 50% OFF is applied: Self-pay 300,000 yen(approximately 2.5 times when 80%)

It depends on whether this 120,000 yen is paid in one lump sum or in installments, and whether there are separate drug costs and consultation fees.Actual monthly burden amountchanges greatly.

Before signing a contract, be sure to check the total cost after benefits are applied and the payment method.

Application conditions for monitor applications include weight, BMI, frequency of hospital visits, etc.

Not everyone is allowed to participate in the monitoring system, but only those determined by the clinic.Applicable conditionsApplies only if the conditions are met.

Commonly presented conditions include maintaining a certain BMI value and excess weight range, maintaining the frequency of hospital visits during the treatment period, and agreeing to provide photos of treatment results and testimonials.

Main items of monitor application conditions
  • Must meet a certain BMI value/overweight range
  • Ability to maintain hospital visit frequency of 2 to 4 times a month
  • Must be able to agree to provide photos and testimonials of treatment results
  • Confirm in writing the scope of use of photos, etc. (SNS, advertisements, web)

Regarding the frequency of hospital visits,2-4 times a monthThere are many cases where patients are required to visit the hospital for a short period of time, and if they are unable to maintain the pace of hospital visits due to work or childcare commitments,Possibility of losing monitor statusThere is.

When applying for benefits, be sure to check the conditions at the time of counseling.

Additionally, if the conditions include providing photos of treatment results or testimonials, the scope of use must be confirmed in writing.

BMI and weight standards are determined based on measured values during counseling, so there have been reports of cases in which the applicability of the same body type was determined differently depending on the person in charge.

To avoid proceeding with a contract without knowing whether monitoring is applicable or not, ask for the applicable conditions to be presented in writing.

The structure tends to create a gap between the benefit content and the actual cost burden.

The 18-month free benefit provided by Reate Clinic is based on the assumption that the benefit will be applied, and the same conditions may not apply to all subscribers.

If you do not meet the conditions for the monitoring system, or if you are unable to maintain the frequency of hospital visits and lose your monitoring qualifications,Contract at regular rateIt will switch to .

Furthermore, if drug costs and consultation fees for GLP-1 drugs and lipolytic injections are not included in the plan fee,Additional fees will be charged at the time of contractPossibly.

Main reasons for the gap between benefit content and actual cost
  • Cases where the monitoring conditions are not met and the rate is switched to normal rate
  • Cases where drug costs for GLP-1 drugs and fat-dissolving injections are not included in the plan fee
  • Cases in which the actual total payment amount increases due to the addition of loan contract splitting fees

In cases where a loan agreement is recommended,split feewill be added, which will further increase the actual total payment amount.

Be sure to check whether the amount presented at the time of signing the contract is the ``total amount including drug costs and consultation fees'' or ``just the treatment fee.'' If there are additional costs, it is important to have the additional monthly costs clearly stated in writing.

To prevent any discrepancies between the actual cost and the amount you actually pay, do not decide on the contract on the day of the consultation, but instead take the estimate home with you and allow yourself time to calmly examine the total cost.

Total fees and monthly payment guidelines for Liate Clinic

The fee structure of Liate Clinic is as follows:Whether monitoring is applicable/selected plan/loan periodThe final amount will be determined by a combination of these three factors.

The numbers listed in the benefits are just upper limits, and not everyone will receive the same benefits.

Three perspectives to understand the overall picture of fees
  • Numerical comparison of total amount before and after monitor application
  • Monthly payment amount varies depending on loan period and treatment plan
  • Costs that are likely to occur during hospital visits, such as additional fees and drug costs

The actual cost will vary greatly depending on the results of the monitor examination and the type of treatment selected, so it is important to understand the fee structure before counseling.Preventing problems after signing a contractThis is important.

There may also be additional costs incurred during hospital visits that are not clearly stated in the contract.

We will organize the overall cost picture using numbers and facts from the following three perspectives.

The sense of burden changes when comparing the total amount before and after applying the monitor numerically.

In the Rieto Clinic's monitoring system,Providing photos of the treatment progress and continuing to visit the hospital for a certain period of timeetc. are applicable conditions.

The total cost of a regular plan varies depending on the treatment content, but it has been reported that a standard course that combines multiple fat freezing, GLP-1, and fat dissolving injections costs around 600,000 yen without monitoring.

The actual cost after the monitor is applied is even if the 80% OFF benefit is applied.Around 120,000 yenis the standard.

Before counseling, be sure toSelf-pay amount after benefits are appliedPlease check.

If 50% OFF is applied, the burden will beAround 300,000 yenIt becomes.

Before signing a contract, be sure to explicitly ask the clinic about what will happen if you fail the monitor screening.

Monthly payment amount varies depending on loan period and treatment plan combination

At Reate Clinic, it is common for the total amount to be paid in installments using a medical loan.

The loan period is12 to 60 paymentsIt can often be set within a range of , and the monthly payment amount varies greatly depending on the period and total amount.

If the total amount after applying the monitor is 150,000 yen, the monthly payment will be approximately 36 times.4,200 yen, about 12 monthly payments12,500 yenis the standard.

Medical loans charge interest. If you choose 60 installments,Actual total amount paid including interestPlease understand that this will add tens of thousands of yen to the total contract amount before signing the contract.

We also recommend that you check with the clinic in advance about what they will do if your loan company does not pass the screening process.

Also, check your contract to see if your monthly payments will change if you change your treatment plan midway through.

It is also necessary to check the costs that are likely to occur during hospital visits, such as additional fees and drug costs.

Expenses not included in the total contract amount for Liate Clinic are:GLP-1 injection drug cost, oral drug cost, blood test costThere are cases where this may occur separately.

GLP-1 injection has drug costs10,000 to 30,000 yen per monthThe longer the hospital stay, the more the cumulative costs will increase.

List of additional costs that are likely to occur during hospital visits
  • Drug cost for GLP-1 injection: Approximately 10,000 to 30,000 yen per month (separate charges may apply)
  • Oral medication cost/blood test cost
  • Additional charges when adding the number of fat-dissolving injections or changing the treatment area
  • Hospital transportation expenses (accumulated costs increase as frequency increases)

Additional charges may also be incurred if you request to add the number of fat-dissolving injections or change the treatment area.

For additional costs that are not listed in the contract, please ask at the time of counseling.Costs not included in this planYou can avoid billing troubles later by asking specific questions such as "I would like you to list all of them."

If the frequency of hospital visits is higher than expected, transportation costs will also be an expense that cannot be ignored.

In addition to the monthly treatment fee, it also includes drug costs, transportation costs, and additional treatment costs.Actual monthly costCalculate the amount before deciding whether to sign a contract.

Conditions and precautions for early cancellation/refund guarantee/cooling-off

When considering canceling a contract after signing a contract, if you do not know the procedure and the rules for calculating the refund amount in advance, you may be surprised to find out the refund amount is less than expected.

Cancellation of contract for aesthetic medical care, not limited to Reate ClinicSpecified Commercial Transactions LawThere are two routes: a cooling-off system based on the above, and a refund for normal early cancellation.

Three points: cancellation, refund, and cooling-off
  • Cooling-off requests must be made within 8 days of receiving the contract document.
  • In the case of mid-term cancellation, the refund amount will be the amount after deducting the number of completed treatments and administrative fees.
  • To avoid cancellation problems, check the refund policy in writing before signing the contract.

Liate Clinic's treatment menu and actual effects

The main treatments provided by Liate Clinic are:Fat freezing/GLP-1 injection/fat dissolving injectionThere are 3 types.

Each has a different mechanism of action, and the types of problems they are good at and the length of time it takes to see effects are different.

Characteristics and effects of the three main treatments
  • Fat freezing: Non-surgical treatment that destroys fat by freezing. It takes several weeks to see results.
  • GLP-1 injection: Aiming for whole body weight management by supplementing appetite suppressing hormone
  • Fat-dissolving injection: Suitable for localized thinning, but requires multiple hospital visits
  • If the number of treatments and hospital visits is insufficient, it will be difficult to obtain the desired effect.

``Which treatment should you choose?'' will be guided through counseling, but by understanding the characteristics of each treatment in advance,Judge the validity of the proposal yourselfIt becomes easier.

The effectiveness of the treatment will vary depending on the combination of the number of visits, lifestyle habits, and physical condition, so be careful not to sign a contract based only on the benefits.

Fat freezing is a procedure that destroys fat by freezing it, and it takes several weeks for it to take effect.

Fat freezing aims to cool fat cells to necrosis and expel them from the body.non-surgicalIt's a treatment.

During the treatment, the applicator is applied to the target area and continues to cool down to a temperature range where fat cells become necrotic.

Necrotic fat cells are drained out of the body through the lymphatic vessels, but this draining process takes time, so the effects are generally felt 2 to 3 weeks after the treatment.

Summary of features of fat freezing
  • A non-surgical treatment that cools and necrotizes fat cells and drains them from lymph vessels.
  • You can feel the effect from the treatmentAfter 2-3 weeks
  • The reduced fat cells will not return to normal, but the remaining cells will enlarge and change your body shape.
  • Multiple treatments may be required depending on the area and target value.

It is unique in that it physically reduces fat cells in one treatment, and the reduced fat cells will not return to their original state.

However, as the remaining fat cells enlarge, your body shape will change, so if your eating habits are disrupted after the procedure, there is an increased risk of rebound.

The effect of fat cooling is not achieved in just one treatment; multiple treatments may be required depending on the area and target value. Please confirm the estimated number of sessions required at the time of counseling.

During the treatment, you may feel discomfort due to the strong suction and cooling, and it has also been reported that temporary redness and numbness may occur after the treatment.

GLP-1 injection aims to reduce weight by replenishing the hormone that suppresses appetite

GLP-1is a type of gastrointestinal hormone secreted from the small intestine after ingesting a meal, and is involved in promoting insulin secretion and suppressing appetite.

The GLP-1 injection provided at Liate Clinic supplements the function of this hormone with a drug,Lose weight while reducing food intake naturallyThis is a treatment that aims to

It is suitable for whole body weight management because it is an approach that reduces calorie intake itself rather than forcibly destroying fat physically.

Summary of characteristics of GLP-1 injection
  • Using drugs to supplement the function of gastrointestinal hormones secreted from the small intestine after meals
  • An approach that aims to manage body weight while naturally reducing calorie intake
  • Gastrointestinal side effects such as nausea, constipation, and diarrhea have been reported.
  • In some cases, drug costs can be around 10,000 to 30,000 yen per month in addition to the treatment fee.

The effects vary depending on your constitution, with some people experiencing a noticeable decrease in appetite and others having difficulty perceiving any change.

GLP-1 preparations have been reported to have gastrointestinal side effects such as nausea, constipation, and diarrhea. If you have any pre-existing medical conditions or are taking any medications, please prioritize consulting with your doctor before counseling.

In many clinics, drug costs are charged separately from treatment fees, which affects the actual monthly costs.

Check whether the drug fee is included in the total amount when signing the contract, and if it is not included,Additional monthly costsCalculate it and then make a decision.

Fat-dissolving injections are suitable for partial thinning, but require multiple visits to the hospital.

Lipolytic injection is a procedure in which a drug is directly injected into the fat layer to dissolve and expel fat cells, and is used to treat areas such as the abdomen, upper arms, and face line.localized fatcan be approached.

It is positioned as a treatment that aims to adjust the shape of a specific area rather than reducing the weight of the entire body.

There is an upper limit to the amount of fat that can be dissolved in one injection, so the larger the amount of change you are aiming for, the more you will need to visit the hospital multiple times.

  • Swelling and internal bleeding may occur after the procedure, but will subside within a few days to a week.
  • Please check the type, concentration, and injection amount of the drug used before undergoing the treatment.
